sentences.text: Jackie is a 2016 biographical drama film directed by Pablo Larraín and written by Noah Oppenheim .	Pablo Larraín	Pablo Larraín	Noah Oppenheim	Noah Oppenheim	biographical	Biographical film	drama film	Drama (film and television)

The film stars Natalie Portman as Jackie Kennedy and tells the story about her life after the 1963 assassination of her husband John F. Kennedy .	Natalie Portman	Natalie Portman	Jackie Kennedy	Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis	1963 assassination of her husband John F. Kennedy	Assassination of John F. Kennedy

Peter Sarsgaard , Greta Gerwig , Billy Crudup and John Hurt also star ; it was Hurt 's final film released before his death in January 2017 .	Peter Sarsgaard	Peter Sarsgaard	Greta Gerwig	Greta Gerwig	Billy Crudup	Billy Crudup	John Hurt	John Hurt

The film was selected to compete for the Golden Lion at the 73rd Venice International Film Festival , and was released in the United States on December 2 , 2016 , by Fox Searchlight Pictures to positive reviews and was nominated for three Oscars at the 89th Academy Awards : Best Actress -LRB- Portman -RRB- , Best Original Score and Best Costume Design .
